description: Main system log (general messages from kernel, daemons, etc.). In an IdM deployment, also carries some DNS (named) and PKI (Dogtag) subsystem messages.
Security and authentication (SSH, sudo, PAM, failed logins)
Mail server related messages; postfix / mail transfer agent + Dovecot (default on RHEL)
Kernel ring buffer (hardware detection and drivers at boot)
Last login information per user (binary - use lastlog)
YUM package manager activity (RHEL 7 and earlier)
Audit daemon logs (includes SELinux AVC denials)
Apache HTTP Server access log. In an IdM deployment, also serves the Web UI and the XML-RPC/JSON-RPC API.
Apache HTTP Server error log. In an IdM deployment, also serves the Web UI and the XML-RPC/JSON-RPC API.
Persistent systemd journal storage (binary - use journalctl)
Chrony time synchronization logs; chrony NTP logs directory (measurements, statistics, tracking)
Primary log file for the Kerberos KDC server
Primary log file for the Kerberos administration server (kadmind)
SSSD main directory (contains multiple component logs)
Per-domain log (LDAP communication for each domain in sssd.conf)
Short-lived helper process for Kerberos authentication
Short-lived helper process for obtaining Kerberos tickets for LDAP
Directory Server (LDAP) audit log (when auditing enabled)
PostgreSQL logs (RHEL default location when logging_collector is on)
Podman/container logs (or use podman logs / journalctl)
Kubernetes / CRI-O pod logs (if using OpenShift/K8s)
Private/temporary logs used by some services
DHCP server messages (default location for dhcpd)
Dedicated DHCP server log (if configured via log-facility in dhcpd.conf)
DHCP lease database (not a log, but critical for troubleshooting)
realmd messages (often appear in system log)
Ansible control node log (enabled via log_path in ansible.cfg)
Ansible Automation Platform / AWX / Tower logs
Automation Controller (Web / Application) — main application logs: runtime errors, web requests, general messages.
Callback Receiver — handles Ansible job callback events.
Dispatcher — job scheduling and execution worker service.
Job Lifecycle — job state changes, blocked jobs, and blocking conditions.
IdM server installation log, from ipa-server-install.
IdM replica installation log, from ipa-replica-install.
IdM client enrollment log, from ipa-client-install.
IPA CLI / RPC error log, under the invoking user's own home directory (the effective system user running the ipa command, not a fixed system-wide path).
Certificate System (Dogtag) logs, one subdirectory per subsystem (ca/, kra/, and so on) when IdM's integrated CA is enabled.
Custodia secrets-service logs — IdM's internal service for distributing secrets (keys, passwords) between its own subsystems.
Log rotation policy snippets, one per service — not logs themselves, but where each service's rotation schedule and retention are configured.
Management Playbooks — management playbook runs and isolated job metadata operations.
Task System — background tasks (cluster management, analytics gathering/processing).
rsyslog — errors authenticating or sending logs to external aggregators.
Websocket Relay — websocket relay server communication.
rsyslog Configurer — rsyslog configuration activity for external logging.
RBAC / Database — RBAC database migration and upgrade logs.
Callback Receiver (supervisord) — the supervisord-managed callback receiver process.
Daphne / Websocket — ASGI communication for the Web UI.
Other supervisord-managed service logs — various components beyond the callback receiver and Daphne above.
